title: Corrective-Design Dataflow Feasibility and Source-Allowlist Amendment

feasibility_finding.gap: The Step5 posterior features are derived from reference/candidate classifier logits, but the current selector is invoked inside the alignment model before those counterfactual embeddings are classified in the runner.
current_order: v0.33 selector invocation from 7 quality/compatibility features
feasibility_finding.consequence: The Step5 correction cannot be implemented solely by widening the controller input; the reference/candidate posterior context does not exist at the current selector call site.

amended_exact_dataflow.name: TWO_STAGE_COUNTERFACTUAL_CONTEXT_THEN_SELECTOR_FINALIZATION
stage_A: Alignment model computes aligned text/vision, quality, compatibility and interaction representation.

Using the existing deterministic reference/candidate action equations, alignment model constructs stable reference and candidate counterfactual fused embeddings without requiring learned selector output.
Alignment model returns the context needed by the runner for counterfactual classification; no final learned-intervention fused embedding is treated as complete at this point.
stage_B: Runner applies the existing classification model to stable reference and candidate counterfactual fused embeddings.
Runner computes detached class-1 posterior probabilities p_ref_pos and p_cand_pos and signed delta_pos = p_cand_pos - p_ref_pos without labels.
Runner supplies only these three detached posterior-context tensors back through an explicit v0.33 finalization interface.

Alignment/controller finalization concatenates the frozen seven features with the three posterior-context features, computes the 10-D selector logit/probability/gate, and constructs the final learned-intervention fused embedding.
Runner classifies that finalized fused embedding for the ordinary candidate prediction and uses the same frozen label-indexed counterfactual logits only for training-time u_target supervision.
amended_exact_dataflow.rationale: Reference and candidate counterfactual actions are deterministic functions of quality/compatibility evidence and therefore can be constructed before learned selector gating; their logits can consequently provide inference-available selector context without using the final selector-dependent fused embedding.

anti_leakage_and_gradient_boundary.ordinary_classification_gradient_semanti: Preserve existing classifier training semantics; Step5A authorizes no new selector-loss gradient route into classifier or encoder parameters.

amended_source_modification_allowlist.role: Accept/validate the three detached posterior-context tensors during explicit finalization; concatenate 7+3 features; widen selector first layer 7->10; preserve target/loss/output/intervention semantics.
Separate v0.33 counterfactual-context preparation from posterior-conditioned selector finalization while preserving existing reference/candidate action equations and unrelated architectures.

Orchestrate the explicit two-stage v0.33 path: classify reference/candidate counterfactual embeddings, derive detached label-free posterior context, request finalization, then classify final fused embedding; preserve training target/loss constants.
Regression tests for 10-D selector, posterior semantics, detach/anti-leakage, shape/finite contracts and preserved selector/intervention semantics.
Regression tests for two-stage training/observability path and required post-correction diagnostics.

implementation_constraints: Only the v0.33 utility-supervised intervention architecture may receive the new two-stage path.
Unrelated fusion architectures must remain behaviorally unchanged.
Reference/candidate counterfactual action equations must remain unchanged.
No second trainable classifier head may be introduced.
The existing classification model must be reused for reference, candidate and final fused embeddings.
No ground-truth-derived quantity may participate in selector inference features.
No utility-loss gradient may propagate through detached posterior-context features into classifier logits.
No threshold, loss-family, utility-loss-weight, seed or training-schedule change is authorized.
No formal-evaluation or official-test path may be invoked.
required_implementation_regressions: Stage-A reference/candidate embeddings are selector-output independent.
Reference/candidate posterior features are exactly softmax(logits,dim=1)[:,1] and signed difference.
Posterior features are detached and label-free.
Final selector_logit and utility_probability preserve existing shapes.
Final fused embedding is produced only after posterior-conditioned selector finalization.
u_target remains label-indexed training supervision only.
BCEWithLogits utility objective and effective weight remain unchanged.
Existing v0.33 observability fields remain available and new posterior-context diagnostics are finite.
